title: Label and value fields
description: Label and value rows, as lines or a two-column table, under an optional heading. A value the data lacks prints a blank rule and is listed to complete.

rows.description: A list of { label, value, what?, sameLine? }; sameLine puts a row on the line of the row before it when it fits.

size.description: Text size of the rows, points.

sameLineGap.description: Points before a row on the line of the row before it (24).
